data.one_liner: A Flutter package for interactive onboarding tours with spotlights, animated hand pointers, and live tracking.
data.what_it_does: It lets you highlight widgets with a moving spotlight that stays aligned as the UI changes. An animated hand pointer can demonstrate gestures, and multi‑step tours can guide users through the app. All overlays are managed by a controller and require no extra runtime dependencies.
use_when: Teaching complex gestures like pinch or drag
avoid_when: You need a pure‑code solution without UI overlays
App must run on non‑Flutter platforms
strengths: Customizable animated pointer (hand, emoji, SVG, Lottie, Rive)
weaknesses: Only works within Flutter (no web‑only libs)
data.setup_notes: Add keyspot to pubspec, import the package, wrap your app with KeyspotScope and use KeyspotController to show spotlights or tours.
